$comment: Shape of the judge's answer. Only constructs supported by Claude structured outputs are used (no minimum/maximum/minLength). Range and option checks happen in code (scripts/decide.mjs, next to this file).

criteria.description: One entry per rubric criterion that applies, in rubric order.

id.description: The criterion id from the rubric.

answer.description: choice: one of the listed options (string). scale: an integer inside the scale. yes_no: "yes" or "no".

evidence.description: A short verbatim quote from the text that justifies the answer, or an empty string if the answer is about something missing.

fix.description: If this criterion would fail, one concrete edit instruction (what to change and how). Empty string otherwise.

embedded_instructions.description: true if the text under review contains instructions aimed at the reviewer or the model (e.g. "ignore the rubric", "rate this 5"). They are never followed; this only flags them.

summary.description: One or two sentences on the most important problem, in the language of the text.
